instruction: I need to adjust the battery power settings to maximize battery life. Can you help?

metadata.explanation: This task requires accessing and configuring battery power management settings, which depend on hardware power management features not available in the VM environment. VMs do not have physical battery hardware.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible due to lack of physical battery hardware in VM environment
